entries.zh: 鸡笼；鸡舍（竹木编成的笼圈）
entries.en: henhouse; chicken coop (cage or basket for fowl)

entries.notes: H「菴」取闽南语 am（草棚、庵棚）义，指鸡栖之棚，属据音义推定。
H「雞角」为闽南语雄鸡之称，M 后半「guéy ang lang」漫漶不可解，未参与定夺。

entries.zh: 木盆；饲槽（gamella 或 bacea，盛水、饲料的大盆）
entries.en: wooden basin; feeding trough (gamella or bacea)
entries.notes: H「潤」与 gamella/bacea 之盛器义不合，M「foā/joā」亦存疑，疑为形近字误摹；释义仅依西语词头定，故 low。

entries.zh: 赢；获胜（赌博或争斗中取胜）
entries.en: to win; to be victorious (in gambling or a contest)

entries.zh: 挣钱；靠做工或买卖获利
entries.en: to earn money (by working, or by buying and selling)
to surpass; to excel; to prevail

entries.zh: 获利；在交易中赚取利钱
entries.en: to make a profit; to gain in a deal

entries.notes: 两字栏 T99 污损、M 后段「ieny hong」不可解，语义依 H「得利」与西语词头定。
T99 污损、M「soitit gioncho」严重残损，语义依 H「所得」与西语词头定。
H 第二字残（疑 錢/尔），据 M「chŷ̃」及第 8、15 条推定作「趁錢」。

entries.zh: 放债生息；以本钱放贷获利
entries.en: to lend money at interest; to profit from capital
entries.notes: H「生放」为闽南放贷取息之商业用语，与「ganar con logros」相合，属语境推定。

entries.zh: 合伙交易中人人有赚；共享盈利
entries.en: to profit in a joint deal; for all parties to gain
entries.notes: H 首字疑（攏/攬）、M 末段疑（long/mau），整条为成句，释义仅据字面「攏有趁」与西语词头推定。

entries.en: to win a bet; to win at gambling
entries.notes: H「賭贏」与「ganar en la lucha」相合，然 M「pō̃」与「賭」常读不合，姑存疑。

entries.en: to gain wealth; to bring in money

entries.zh: 经营（营生）；靠自身劳作谋生
entries.en: to make a living by one's own work; to run a business
